author: Yffe
content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (b8169cb). The MULTI-LINE nano editor: Enter inserts newlines, up/down navigate lines, full-screen render positions the cursor by row/col, Ctrl-S saves to a file. VERIFIED (L3): count_nl/line_start/line_end/min2/cursor_row/cursor_col/move_up/move_down/to_1based/render_frame/decode + the edit core (16 L3 items) — the editing+navigation+layout LOGIC is proven. TRUSTED (L1 boundary): raw_mode_on/off/read_key_raw/write_frame/read_file/write_file (the syscalls). Critic NO DIVERGENCE: nav/layout genuinely L3 (mutation >= 0.60 floor; Buffer invariant re-established on move_up/down -> out-of-bounds PROVEN; cursor_row/col drive the actual ANSI position), the editor RUNS multi-line correctly (ab+Enter+cd+UP -> two lines, cursor row1 col3 clamped; 3-line session correct), the file save ROUND-TRIPS (ab\ncd, \n preserved, od -c confirmed), no cheat, no regression (663 tests). Honest: cursor_col bounds (<=cursor) rather than pins the col (above floor, runtime-correct). Runs --no-sandbox (#106 termios ioctl). Worked around #122 (the cast-paren L1 twin) with forward scans (honest, not stubbed).
